preview.subject: HANGS Construction Services 2026 Forms W-2
preview.body:
Hi,

Attached are the 2026 earnings by employee, the payroll ledger by pay run and the 2026 company vehicle use log from our safety manager. Please prepare the 2026 Forms W-2 and the W-3 for us to review; we plan to e-file them with the SSA and mail the employee copies by the deadline.

The earnings file is the final year-end export from the payroll system. The Q1 to Q3 Forms 941 are filed; the Q4 941 is prepared and we will file it together with the W-2s.

Two things I am not sure about. Alicia Castellano (E-1101) started on December 7 and has applied for her Social Security card; it has not arrived yet. And I do not think payroll ever picked up the personal use of the two pickups in the vehicle log.

Thanks,
Dana Whitfield
Controller, HANGS Construction Services LLC

sources.title: Form W-2 Reporting of Employer-Sponsored Health Coverage

passages.q: Must HANGS report the cost of employer-sponsored health coverage with code DD?
passages.a: Employers required to file fewer than 250 Forms W-2 for the preceding calendar year (determined without application of any entity aggregation rules for related employers) ... Optional.

sources.title: General Instructions for Forms W-2 and W-3 (2026)

passages.q: When are the 2026 Forms W-2 and W-3 due, and must they be e-filed?
passages.a: The due date for filing 2026 Forms W-2 ... and W-3 ... with the SSA is February 1, 2027, whether you file using paper forms or electronically. ... Generally, you must furnish Copies B, C, and 2 of Form W-2 to your employees by February 1, 2027. ... You must e-file Forms W-2 ... if you are required to file at least 10 information returns.

passages.q: What goes in box 1, and are the 401(k) deferrals and Washington Paid Leave premiums in it?
passages.a: Box 1-Wages, tips, other compensation. Show the total taxable wages, tips, and other compensation that you paid to your employee during the year. However, do not include elective deferrals (such as employee contributions to a section 401(k) or 403(b) plan) ... You must include the employee contribution and the employer voluntary payment as wages on the Form W-2.

passages.q: What are the 2026 Social Security limits for boxes 3 and 4, and what goes in boxes 5 and 6?
passages.a: The total of boxes 3 and 7 cannot exceed $184,500 (2026 maximum social security wage base). ... For 2026, the amount should not exceed $11,439 ... there is no wage base limit for Medicare tax ... an employer is required to withhold a 0.9% Additional Medicare Tax on any Federal Insurance Contributions Act (FICA) wages ... in excess of $200,000 in a calendar year.

sources.title: Publication 15-B (2026), Employer's Tax Guide to Fringe Benefits

passages.q: How is the personal use of each pickup valued?
passages.a: Multiply the annual lease value by the percentage of personal miles out of total miles driven by the employee. ... 54,000 to 55,999 14,250 ... For automobiles with an FMV of more than $59,999, the annual lease value equals (0.25 x the FMV of the automobile) + $500. ...
